sections.appearance: Nagisa has long ash blonde hair with flower ornaments stretching from the top of her head to her left ear. On her back are a pair of angel wings that sprouts out from the waist. Halo ==== Her halo consists of a red circle, that has ten thorns sticking out of it. Five of the thorns are thinner, and have a semi-circle base. They also merge with the circle, unlike the rest. Uniform ==== She wears a mid-length, cream skirt dress, with golden buttons, and accents around the edges of the skirt. The inner side of the skirt is navy. On top of this, she wears her Tea Party capelet with similar design, tied with a dark grey bow. Below her bosom, she has a belt, which holds a pistol holster. For legwear, she has a pair of dark grey pantyhose, and white high heels. Firearm ==== She uses a white Walther PPK pistol with a pink lower slide and grip. The Trinity insignia is imprinted on the grip. Her name is stamped on the front slide. For her EX Skill, she commands a battery of L118 Light Guns.

sections.personality: Nagisa is quite calm and composed, but like everyone else, she has her limit, and she can get quite ruthless once someone breaks her composure. She also tends to overthink things which can sometimes end up causing trouble for other people. Even Sensei called her cynical due to her paranoic behavior.
